decision.hypothesis: Highest composite in the dataset (85, A=92) but organic-v1.1 only 58, and its 2,400/mo is shared with Bellevue WA. SERP verified local to NE. Tests both the model gap and whether shared-name volume is capturable.
decision.successCondition: Meaningful local impressions => shared-name markets are investable and should stop being discounted.
decision.failureCondition: Negligible impressions => shared-name volume must be excluded from scoring entirely.
